name: FrameViewer
tagline: 启用照片原生连续胶片，拖动定位视频并连贯切换相邻内容。
description: FrameViewer（帧检视器）启用系统“照片”的原生连续胶片浏览，让照片缩略图与视频画面在同一条滚动带中移动。
拖动可定位视频进度，越过视频边缘即可继续切换相邻照片或视频，无需进入编辑模式或修改原始媒体。
notice: ⚠️ 最低需要 iOS 18.0。0.1.6 Rootless 已在 iPhone 11 Pro / iOS 18.5 上确认可用；RootHide 与其他系统版本仍需测试。
features: 照片与视频共用同一条原生连续胶片
支持拖动定位视频并跨越边缘切换相邻内容
无需进入编辑模式且不会修改原始视频
胶片显示时隐藏系统进度条及对应的 LiquidAss 覆盖滑块
保留播放、暂停和静音按钮，停用后恢复系统原有控件
默认关闭，可随时在设置中启用或停用
支持 English、简体中文和繁體中文
usage: 安装后重新打开“设置”和“照片”。
前往“设置”中的帧检视器并开启“启用帧检视器”。
在照片中正常浏览或播放内容，通过底部连续胶片拖动定位或切换相邻项目。

changes: 改用照片原生连续胶片，照片与视频画面在同一条滚动带中移动。
支持拖动定位视频并跨越视频边缘切换相邻内容，同时移除固定中间进度区域。
胶片显示时隐藏系统进度条及 LiquidAss 覆盖滑块，保留播放、暂停和静音控制。
首次发布：在普通视频播放页面显示胶片预览并支持拖动定位。
新增默认关闭的设置开关、设置图标与三语言界面。
提供 Rootless 与 RootHide 软件包，最低支持 iOS 18.0。

en.name: FrameViewer
en.tagline: Native continuous filmstrip browsing in Photos with video seeking and seamless gallery navigation.
description: FrameViewer enables the native continuous filmstrip retained in Photos, with photo thumbnails and video frames moving together in one scrolling strip.
Drag to seek within a video, then continue past its edge to neighboring photos or videos without entering Edit or changing the original media.
en.notice: ⚠️ Requires iOS 18.0 or later. Version 0.1.6 Rootless is user-confirmed on an iPhone 11 Pro running iOS 18.5; RootHide and other system versions still require testing.
features: One native continuous filmstrip shared by photos and videos
Drag to seek within a video and continue past its edge to neighboring items
No need to enter Edit and no changes to the original video
Hides the system progress bar and matching LiquidAss slider overlay while the filmstrip is visible
Keeps play, pause, and mute controls and restores original controls when disabled
Disabled by default with an enable or disable switch in Settings
English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
usage: Reopen Settings and Photos after installation.
Open FrameViewer in Settings and enable Enable FrameViewer.
Browse or play media normally in Photos and drag the bottom filmstrip to seek or move to neighboring items.

changes: Switched to the native continuous filmstrip with photos and video frames moving in one scrolling strip.
Added drag-to-seek with navigation past video edges to neighboring items and removed the fixed center scrubber.
Hides the system progress bar and matching LiquidAss overlay while retaining play, pause, and mute controls.
Initial release with filmstrip previews and drag-to-seek controls during normal video playback.
Added a disabled-by-default Settings switch, Settings icon, and three-language interface.
Added Rootless and RootHide packages with iOS 18.0 as the minimum version.
